name: CodeRabbit
tagline: AI code review on every pull request, IDE, and CLI.
description: CodeRabbit posts contextual, line-by-line AI reviews on pull requests across GitHub and GitLab, with an agentic chat for follow-ups plus integrated linters and SAST tools. The same reviewer runs in the IDE (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf) and from a CLI, so issues surface before the PR.
insight: Raised a $60M Series B (Scale Venture Partners, incl. NVIDIA's NVentures) in 2025 at a ~$550M valuation.

modelSupport.notes: Orchestrates multiple LLMs for review and chat.

edge: Free Pro-tier reviews for all public/OSS repos with no seat limits, billing paid teams by agent-minute not per PR.
pros: Free for public and open-source repos
Reviews in PR, IDE, and CLI
cons: Can be noisy on large PRs
